description: Saves a wave.botrecipe/1 bot draft for a person to finish in Wave's bot builder. Returns draft_id, checks and a one-time continue_url (7 days) to give that person. Draft only: you never mint, sign, spend or get a name. Max 20 open drafts. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). Failed checks: error draft_invalid with checks.

recipe.description: wave.botrecipe/1: name, slug?, pitch (≤90), category, tags (≤8), about, personality, rules { mode, freePerUserPerDay… no pricing }, knowledge (≤40: "v3:N" refs or { title, text ≤1,800 bytes, private? }), design? (wave.avatar/1 pixel20, ≤4 KB)

name: bot_draft_save
title: Save a bot draft
